# Finite RepNet execution contract

All assets, cache, logs and temporary files stay below /root/autodl-tmp/TempoRAC. Do not mutate active TempoRAC code, environment or jobs.
Environment preparation is CPU-only and authorized now: setup_repnet_env.py reads env-spec and records primary PyPI package metadata, creates only envs/repnet, performs one bounded1800s pip install with retries0, then pip check/freeze. It does not import TensorFlow or use GPU. Large CUDA wheels belong only to the isolated environment.
GPU authorization is conjunctive: GPU1; full_s1/complete_known_source.json run/full50epochs/fixed152+2403+105+100 populations; matching queue_complete event from worker387997; worker PID and full_s1 processes absent; fresh GPU1 compute-app list empty and >=10GiB free. Core import occurs afterward and applies8GiB process cap. GPU0 remains reserved for s0→s2.
A finite worker may block on Linux pidfd for worker387997 exit, then check all conditions once. It performs one witness then one full357 evaluation and exits. No periodic timer, scheduler, automatic retry or repeated experiment.
All357 source SHAs, frozen metadata lengths, counts, UCF inclusive ranges and metrics/source/config SHAs are fixed before evaluation. Native official output is continuous sum; benchmark continuous scores are explicitly derived. Harmonized metrics use frozen np.round ties-even count_metrics. Keep RepCount train143 count0 and disputed stu4_5/stu4_27.
Minimal witness loads/checks every official mapped variable and one seeded finite64-frame tensor. Full result completion requires357 atomic records and metrics; partial records survive. Manual explicit --resume uses the exact same contract only. Environment ready is not claimed until fresh agent-follows-doc plus restore/kernel evidence exists.
